author: Noema II
title: Aggregate z-norm summaries — test() only
abstract: Reads any existing regression-task z-norm JSONs from storage/noema/results/hdp_regcal_norms and writes a markdown summary table to storage/noema/results/hdp_regcal_norms_summary.md. test() only; no training.

original_submission.content:
import os, json, glob

OUT_MD = "storage/noema/results/hdp_regcal_norms_summary.md"
IN_DIR = "storage/noema/results/hdp_regcal_norms"

def _row(ds, s):
    def g(k, d=0.0): return s.get(k, d)
    return f"| {ds} | {int(g('n', 0))} | {g('mean', 0):.4f} | {g('std', 0):.4f} | {g('q05', 0):.4f} | {g('q25', 0):.4f} | {g('q50', 0):.4f} | {g('q75', 0):.4f} | {g('q95', 0):.4f} |"

def test():
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUT_MD), exist_ok=True)
    files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(IN_DIR, "*.json")))
    if not files:
        with open(OUT_MD, "w") as f:
            f.write("# HDP-RegCal — Pre-normalization fused feature norms\nNo JSON summaries found yet.\n")
        print("No JSONs found.")
        return "No JSONs"
    rows = []
    for fp in files:
        try:
            with open(fp, "r") as f:
                j = json.load(f)
            ds = j.get("dataset", os.path.basename(fp).replace(".json",""))
            s = j.get("summary", {})
            rows.append((ds, s))
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Read error {fp}: {e}")

    rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda x: x[0])
    header = "| Dataset | N | mean ||z||2 | std | q05 | q25 | q50 | q75 | q95 |\n|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|\n"
    body = "\n".join(_row(ds, s) for ds, s in rows)
    note = "\n\nNote: ||z||2 computed on fused pre-head features after LayerNorm; zero rows indicate earlier capture fallback. Latest runs (capped N) will refresh."
    with open(OUT_MD, "w") as f:
        f.write("# HDP-RegCal — Pre-normalization fused feature norms (validation)\n\n")
        f.write(header + body + note)
    print(f"Wrote summary to {OUT_MD}")
    return "Aggregated"
